settings.remoteHint: Behavior of the provider panel for SSH remote hosts/containers

featureEnabled.title: Enable SSH Remote Features
featureEnabled.description: Enable takeover, batch apply and other enhanced features for SSH remote hosts/containers; turn off to restore native cc-switch and hide all SSH remote entries.

autoImportDefault.title: Auto-read current config from SSH remote
autoImportDefault.description: When enabled, the default card shows the remote machine's current app config in real time; when off, it no longer actively pulls the latest config so the UI refreshes faster.
autoImportDefault.note: Note: this setting only applies to Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok Build; OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes always follow the current app.

proxy.enableFeature: Show App Takeover Toggles on Main Page
proxy.enableFeatureDescription: When enabled, per-app takeover toggles (send that app's requests through the local route) will appear at the top of the main page; a flowing border on a toggle means the routing master switch is on
proxy.marqueeHint: When the app switches at the top of the main page show a flowing border, it means the local proxy service (routing master switch) is running

quotaDisplay.title: Quota Display
quotaDisplay.description: Control how quota usage is displayed on provider cards
quotaDisplay.expandedDescription: When enabled: quota usage displays in a separate panel below the card (with total/used/remaining/reset time); when disabled: quota is embedded inline (e.g. '5h: 5%')

settings.enableFloatingWindowDescription: Show a floating widget with each app's provider, model and usage
settings.floatingSnapSpeedDescription: Control the snap/open animation speed (fast or slow); select "Off" to skip the snap animation
settings.floatingLockedDesc: When locked, the floating window cannot be dragged or auto-snap (click still opens the main window)
settings.floatingPinDesc: Shows this app in the floating window when selected; choose "Follow current app" to update automatically when switching apps
settings.floatingOpacityDesc: Adjust the opacity of the floating window background and border (20% ~ 100%)
settings.floatingAutoCollapseDesc: Collapse to a color strip when dropped near screen edge; auto-expand on mouse hover

appVisibility.showUpdateBadgeDescription: Show a green icon in the header when a new version is available. Background checks still run when disabled; you can check manually on the About page
